description: Sole proprietor taxes / налоги ИП упрощенка / ЖК салықтары. Calculates, for an individual entrepreneur (ИП) without employees on the simplified declaration (form 910.00), the half-year tax and the mandatory monthly payments for themselves in 2026: OPV, OPVR, SO and VOSMS, with the exemptions for pensioners, people born before 1975 and people with disabilities. Ask the user for the declared monthly income: it is required and sets the contribution base.

has_disability.description: Any disability: VOSMS is paid by the state.

has_permanent_group_1_2_disability.description: Group I or II disability established permanently: also exempt from OPV and OPVR.

is_pensioner.description: Pensioner: exempt from OPV, OPVR, SO and VOSMS.

lang.description: Language of source titles, limitation notes and page links: "ru" (Russian) or "kk" (Kazakh). Default "ru".

monthly_declared_income_kzt.description: Monthly income the entrepreneur declares for contributions, in tenge. The base is limited to 1–50 MZP (1–7 MZP for SO).

semiannual_income_kzt.description: Income for the half-year, in tenge (KZT).

tax_rate.description: Tax rate on income as a fraction: 0.02, 0.03, 0.04 (default), 0.05 or 0.06, as set by the local maslikhat.

name: kz_ip910_taxes
title: Kazakhstan sole proprietor on the simplified declaration (form 910), 2026
